text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in the cafeteria—
Fine Motion and Tap Dance City were cornering Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Shakur-san~.
You're underestimating us way too much, don't ya think?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's no "what's going on" about it!
Just take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Quit staring at that!!
Damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Generative AI.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just messing around.
Thought I'd see if I could interpret existing data from a different angle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Slap a realistic skin on it, and I can gather dialogue data too. Without having to deal with tedious chitchat.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And here I thought Shakur actually answered my video call for once...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That girl popped up and claimed she was Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Crazy, right?
Lying is no good.
Besides, it doesn't look like you at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I take another close look at "her" on the tablet screen. Glaring back at us, Air Shakur—
choice_data_list: ...Doesn't it look kind of like her?

text_block_list.name: Shakur & The Two
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
NO!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! The looks and responses are damn near flawless!
Isn't that pretty much how I look from an objective point of view?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And yet you guys keep whining...
Tell me, where the hell is it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's cooompletely off!
You just don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: First off, Shakur isn't nearly that grumpy!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So listen up!
Throw in all the traits I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, back off!
...Ah, damn it, I'll do it, so get off me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Perfect!
Now this is Air Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How the hell is this me?!
This is just you, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not this damn cringe!
Are you blind or what?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, frankly speaking...
There might be a filter of personal affection over it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Affection?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Look at ya.
You pursue what you love as much as you want...
You know the path you ought to take, and you've got the brains to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's downright charming, isn't it? I just want someone like that to enjoy a fulfilling voyage, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Agreed!
I couldn't agree more!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, are you blushing~?
What a cutie!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's entirely different, you know?
Shakur is, well...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I know! Could you modify the AI according to what I say?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu!
How wonderful, absolutely lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Cool, noble, and dignified...
Yes! Just like the King of the Demon Realm♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is... ah, right!
Let's give this Shakur a cape—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're done here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a shame! I wanted to look at it a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm not your damn toy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! But truly, you're far cooler than you give yourself credit for.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Understanding the world while constantly aiming higher...
You're a seeker of truth worthy of respect, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You really know how to phrase things in the most refined way possible, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪ By the way...
Can this AI visit my smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, me too, me too!
Give me AI Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like hell I will, idiots!
